scope: Original CC0 fixture, no rendering; 300 cooperative updates including guest startup, not guest display frames. Shared machine, sequential samples. No game speedup projection.

reports.method: Same machine, serial full builds, discarded fresh-instance warmup + seven fresh-instance samples; 300 updates including startup, not guest presents; no rendering.

memory.scope: heavy-gate physical headroom at phase entry; not a reservation

pipeline_metrics.phase_timing_scope: phase wall times except C generation: summed child CPU, nested within lift (which reanalyzes); not additive
pipeline_metrics.wasm_bytes_per_insn_scope: total module including profile/asyncify; not marginal lifted-code cost
